name: Nenmaku Jun'ai ~Kiss x 900 Kanrinin-san no Ponytail wa, Kyou mo Kurokatta
original_name: 粘膜純愛 ～ KISS×900 管理人さんのポニーテールは、今日も黒かった
source:
The protagonist, Shichirouta Nanakamado, managed to secure a job offer and successfully graduated from college.

Tomorrow is finally the company’s orientation ceremony. Shichirouta is overcome with nervousness and anxiety…

But then, to his shock, the company he was supposed to join suddenly went bankrupt.

What will become of Shichirouta’s future…?

[from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/828789/?gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
